what: One server pause point in POST /draft (saveDraft), after its base check (baseVersion === currentVersion) and before the draft is written: for a curl-only draft whose check passed on the base an update is about to replace, and whose write lands after the update has published and dropped the draft (the two C12b straddle cases: S14 and X-a12-versions-2). Its own helper (functions/src/lib/e2eC12Gate.ts), so it applies alone or beside amplify-mint-join and amplify-c08-mint-races. Also a probe with no pause (30-editors-question-probe.patch): functions/src/lib/presence.ts liveEditing logs one line per editors question, `[e2e-c12-probe] {docId, at, connected, editors, modes, log, connectedMs, peersMs, logMs}`, to the stack's emulators.log, so C12a can show what the functions' own Database client read when an update was answered (X-c12-agent-vs-editors-2: a mint under N open editors, seen once)
